scripts.test:all: turbo run test test:integration && cargo test --workspace
scripts.format: biome check --write && cargo fmt && taplo format
scripts.check: biome check && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
scripts.release: bun run check:publishable && bun run --filter @build-qube/papyra build && bun run --filter @build-qube/papyra-native create-npm-dirs && bun run --filter @build-qube/papyra-native artifacts && bun run --filter @build-qube/papyra-native publish-platforms && changeset publish
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && git clean -xdf node_modules .turbo target corpus
